rationale: M37.21 C5: the builtin/stdlib exclusion resolves a qualified call by its ROOT segment only. `A.Logger.bar()` has root `A` (user type) and mid-chain `Logger` (stdlib root name) — the pre-fix per-segment walk dropped the call as stdlib (com.mycompany.Service.doWork died on segment `com`; foo.Logger.bar on segment `Logger`). Pin: the calls edge to bar survives; mid-chain collisions never suppress user calls.
